statements.statement: A load balancer can distribute incoming traffic unevenly across servers to create bottlenecks.
statements.explanation: Load balancers are designed to distribute traffic evenly across servers to prevent any single server from becoming a bottleneck and ensure efficient resource utilization.

statements.statement: Load balancers play a critical role in maintaining service availability by redirecting traffic away from servers that have failed.
statements.explanation: Load balancers enhance fault tolerance by detecting failed servers and automatically redirecting traffic to operational servers, thus maintaining the availability of the service.
